notes.title: Music Track Update! & Music Team Interview Is Now Out.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38025298/6625440024e7a2074ce3a4796c9e63e6551cb8f8.png

Hello, we are 18Light Game.

In order to make everyone enjoy a more perfect quality, since the release of "Pronty: Fishy Adventure", we have adjusted the system and added new contents continuously until now.

In this update , TWO brand new songs have been added, you will hear them in specific areas.

Light of Hope：Seeing the light of redemption over and over, makes Pronty keep going with hope.
Sacred Realm：Rearranged based on the theme song, it expresses the sacredness of specific areas.Including the music added this time, FIVE songs will be recorded in "Original Soundtrack" with high-fidelity.

By the way, our interview with "Pronty: Fishy Adventure" music team is uploaded on Youtube!
This is our second time working with composer Yubo Su and recording engineer Paul Chen, the first time being on "Behind the Screen".
After watching this video, maybe you will know more about Royla.

(Don't forget to turn on CC for English subtitles!)
https://youtu.be/QVwGwynAw2Y

notes.title: V1.1 Version Update!
notes.notes:
V1.1 version accumulation update project

New additions and optimization adjustments:
1. Added V-Sync and FPS adjustment functions.
2. Adjusted the game difficulty slightly.
3. Added fast travel waterslides before Golden Chattertooth and Meduso Magna.
4. Added fast travel waterslides before Lamina.
5. Optimized some route navigation.
6. Optimized gamepad detection.
7. Autosave after repairing or using fast travel waterslides.
8. Optimized some areas performance.

Bug Fixed:
1. Fixed a bug that gamepad will easily snap to the diagonals.
2. Fixed somes of english scripts.
3. Fixed a bug that the countdown sound of gate won't stop.
4. Fixed a bug that the first gate before the refinery will keep respawning.
5. Fixed a bug that won't get the encyclopedia of Silver Chattertooth.
6. Fixed a bug that landmark will lost position after placing.
7. Change the price of outpost and custom landmarks.
8. Fixed a bug where the map in the refinery gate would not be unlocked.
9. Fixed a bug that Time bombs will break one-way shortcuts.
10. Fixed a bug that Toby's encyclopedia information was discovered too early. "
11. Fixed a bug of not getting achievements.
12. Fixed a bug of the abnormal handle operations, such as unable to aim, sprint... etc.
13. Fixed a bug that can not go back to the lower left corner of Waste Processing Plant.
14. Fixed a bug that setting fps to 30 will lag.
15. Fixed a bug that buy the ID card directly will make the game progress block.
16. Fixed a bug that gamepad won't show the control tip.
17. Fixed a bug that the information of map beside MINA was not syncing with map in codex.

notes.title: "Pronty" Demo Version Removed.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your like and support of "Pronty".

Since the release, we have received feedback and suggestions from many players, and your help has made the game better. In the future, we will continue to optimize the game, and the current trial version will not be able to fully demonstrate the quality of the game. After discussion, we decided to remove the demo version of "Pronty". After the release, players will not be able to download, install, and start the demo version.

Thank you for participating in the demo, and please support the official version of "Pronty".

notes.title: "Pronty: Fishy Adventure" is about to release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38025298/f5b176cf52803d642926076f38a07168dca3bcd1.png

Hello everyone, we are 18Light Game.

We are happy to announce that after a long period of developing and testing, our game “Pronty; Fishy Adventure” will finally greet the world on November 18th (PST). 

In the game, you play as Protector Pronty to fight off mutant monsters with your bionic swordfish partner Bront in a mysterious underwater world. During your adventure, you will unlock mysteries buried deep in the underwater city of Royla.

The game contains 9 big regions, 41 skill props, up to 60 mutant fish monsters, and easter eggs scattering through the entire map. Many exploration elements are waiting for you to experience.

We had made tons of adjustments and modifications in the official game to allow players to experience the game’s full content and its stories. A brand new map system also helps you discover different regions and hidden objects. Players can also change game difficulties to your liking. 

We hope that everyone can have a wonderful and unique underwater adventure in Pronty; Fishy Adventure.

Finally, we welcome everyone to join our official community to send feedback and suggestions. We are eager to make this game better and better.

18Light Game

notes.title: "Pronty: Fishy Adventure" new version demo is now available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38025298/623cfe200182041727eab1ccae3a7bdc159345b7.png

To thank everyone for your support and encouragement, we released a new version of the demo!
You will be able to play the prologue, explore two major areas, and fight with the first boss "Para-Keto".
This version is supposed to be playable for a total of 60 minutes, you can download it in our store anytime.

In this update, we added "Assist Mode" to support players adjust the difficulty of the levels according to their own abilities.
Hope everyone enjoys our game in the most comfortable way ;)
( Main menu > Options > General > Assist Mode) 

Don't forget to join 18Light Game Discord server and get the latest news!
